isolation.why: IEEE 802.3 §40.6.1.1: 1500 Vrms electric strength → 2121 V peak; IEC 60664-1 Table F.2 case A, PD2, step table → 2.5 kV row = 1.5 mm clearance; working voltage ≤ 3.3 V → creepage (Table F.4) below it, raised to the clearance → 1.5 mm; the gap under the magnetics (pin rows 420 mil apart) holds it without a slot

note: 1000BASE-T MDI: 100 Ω ±10 %, intra-pair ≤ 50 mil, ≤ 2 vias; no plane under the cable side of the magnetics
